name: REF2 machine: model27's second reference machine, a triangle and noise through the stock chain
description: The template for a machine that uses everything the standard lets a machine use (notes/63). REF's contract with a triangle in place of REF's parabola (B4a), and a shortcut, RETRIG + COLOR = Octave, -2 to +2, saved with the sound by the builder's shortcut layer (B4b); a handler on every other hook SAMPLE uses comes in B4c and B4d. Never offered to users.

uses.why: the note's octave, -2 to +2: k 28, which the voice reads at p + 0x38; the shortcut layer saves it

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_compose.py and tools/emu/test_shortcuts.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code, notes/63 §10 and §11.4)
emulation.build: alone, as machine 6 or 7 next to sampler, and as machine 8 of sampler, refmachine, refmachine2
